title: KCP lens_list result (DESIGN.md §10.2, §11.6.1 read family)
description: CommandResult.result payload for lens_list (§11.2 ok arm; the envelope's revision/event_cursor members live outside this payload). §11.5 page of SpaceLens projections (gap notes KG4/KG9). §11.5 page shape verbatim: { items[], next?, snapshot, boundary_event_cursor }. The first page creates a stable snapshot token (expiry >= 15 minutes); further pages see the same logical boundary or return snapshot-expired; authorization is rechecked for every page (gap note KG9).

items.description: Page of SpaceLens projections; at most 512 items (§11.8 page read limit).

cursor.description: Opaque, authenticated cursor or snapshot token (§11.3, §11.5); the 4096-char ceiling is the K0 cursor-cap extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md item 9).

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

lensKind.description: Closed SpaceLens.kind enum, verbatim §10.2 (§11.8: closed); Stream is a lens preset, not a second content model (§10.4).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

query_ast.description: Closed query AST over indexed fields and bounded relation traversal, containing no arbitrary code (§10.2); the AST grammar is not pinned in this slice — open object carrying no authority (gap note KG25).

sort_spec.description: Lens sort specification (§10.2 names the field); shape unpinned (gap note KG25).

presentation_options.description: Lens presentation configuration (§10.2 names the field); shape unpinned (gap note KG25).

visibility.description: Lens visibility token; §10.2 names the field with no value space (gap notes KG6/KG25).

spaceLens.description: SpaceLens projection, field names verbatim from the §10.2 record shape (gap notes KG4/KG25); a lens is declarative presentation over authorized canonical records in one space.

statusToken.description: Bounded lowercase token for a field DESIGN.md names without pinning a value space; pins the shape without inventing an enum (gap note KG6).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time (recorded K0 extraction decision, spec/schemas/README.md item 7); format: date-time additionally requires semantic calendar validity (R0 KENV-05).
